notes.title: 🇵🇱 Celebrate Polish Constitution Days With Otherwar! 🇵🇱
notes.content:
[h3]🌿 The spring is here, and May 3rd is getting closer and closer - get ready to dive into the vortex of creativity to celebrate Polish gamedev![/h3]

[b]It was the third day of May of the year 1791[/b] when the Polish Constitution was signed. It was a modern constitution seeking to implement wide state reforms, advancing democratization of Poland, and including checks and balances and tripartite separation of powers. It was the first such document in Europe, and the [i]second[/i] in the world, following the American one from 1787. To this day, we're celebrating it as one of the [b]peak[/b] achievements of the [i]Age of Enlightenment[/i] in Poland and the foundations of Polish democracy. 

[hr][/hr]

☀️ While historically, 3 May is a very important holiday, we celebrate it in different ways. We quite often take advantage of the warm sun of May and spring in full bloom, lighting up that grill and gathering for a BBQ ♨️ We can't back this up with any scientific data, but this could be the period when most Polish gamers are finally touching grass!

Of course, each to their own, and if you need to take a break from the sun for a bit so you won't overheat, there are also many ways to celebrate indoors! 🥳

🕹️Once again, [b]Acram Digital[/b] is hosting [b]Polish Constitution Days[/b] on Steam to celebrate the rapidly growing Polish gamedev. There are many titles to choose from, and we're proud that [b]Otherwar[/b] is among them! Play it from [b]April 26th to May 3rd[/b] to celebrate the creativity of Polish game creators and check out other games to witness our creativity in its full extent! 🇵🇱

[h3]Welcome to the Steam Tower Defense Fest![/h3]

[h3]Embody the role of the defender angel, summoned to stem the tide of an encroaching hell horde.[/h3]

[b]Unlike other tower defense games, Otherwar's cast of enemies will keep you on your toes, as almost every enemy fires a different kind of projectile. From ever-following eyeballs to slowly approaching wide spider webs, and patterns of swirling leaves cast by undead treants or necromancers, who, if allowed to linger too long, will raise skeletons from the dead that may overwhelm your defenses.[/b]

[h3]Select towers and skills that will aid you in battle and survive—or at least try to survive...[/h3]

notes.title: Protect the Gates of Heaven... forever! ENDLESS mode is here.
notes.content:
[h1]Guardians of Light![/h1]

Thank you for the fantastic reception of [b]Otherwar[/b], the very first commercial game by the small, yet relentless and passionate [b]Kantal Collective[/b]. We've received a lot of feedback to the launch version of the game, as well as many feature requests, encouraging comments, and fair critique. We appreciate you taking your time to give us your thoughts! That's the main way for us to pick the next steps in development and keep improving the game. But what's this? Demonic forces gather at The Gate once more! And looks like this time around, the hosts of demons are... endless!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463314/125a1081a20d66ff9fb91671951e42e56220603b.png[/img]

[h2]Introducing - ENDLESS MODE![/h2]
[list]
[*] A whole new infinite challenge
[*] Unlockable when the player who manages to beat the game on any difficulty level
[*] Three new achievements to go with it
[/list]
The Endless mode is the main feature of this first major post-release update, but it's far from being the only change. There's a lot of tweaks, fixes, and polish that comes with the new version of [b]Otherwar[/b]. Here's the...
[h2]Full CHANGELOG:[/h2]
[h3]Rebalancing and tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] first active skill is always enabled
[*] skills prices changed
[*] attack speed rebalanced
[*] damage rebalanced
[*] cheaper money towers
[/list]
[h3]Changes to towers:[/h3]
[list]
[*] attack indicator for tower laser added
[*] tower freezer - targeting fixed
[*] single upgrade price changed (base - 25, upgrade 1 - 40, upgrade 2 - 50)
[/list]
[h3]Gamepad:[/h3]
[list]
[*] now you can play with gamepad
[*] Xbox or PS controllers can be detect
[*] pause after controller disconnect
[*] crossheir is displayed automatically when playing with gamepad
[*] added auto aim - as an option to switch on/off
[/list]
[h3]Translation fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] reload time - now translated properly
[*] kill enemies - now translated properly
[*] new best time - now translated properly
[*] actual time and best time - now translated properly
[*] all german translations updated
[*] some other translation fixes
[/list]
[h3]UI tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] new preview for skills in the world map and bestiary
[*] on/off icons better placed in settings UI
[*] tooltip added at the end of the level when hoovering of the unlocked tower
[*] slot skills are animated when maneuvering over them in the world map skills panel
[/list]
[h3]Enemies tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] all bosses going to the gate after wave 10
[*] hell hounds speed changed from 1.1 -> 1.2
[*] headless bullet speed changed from 3.0 -> 3.2
[*] eye bullet speed changed from 2.5 -> 2.7
[*] boss demon - armor percentage changed from 1% -> 2%
[*] boss demon - bullet speed from 7 -> 8
[*] boss demon - teleport after every 1000HP (was after 500HP)
[*] boss demon - new shoot sound
[*] boss slime - new shoot sound
[*] boss slime minion - new shoot sound
[*] boss leshen - fixed problem with animation when teleporting
[*] level 1 - slightly easier
[/list]
[h3]Achievement fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] angel of doom - changed to 30k killed enemies
[*] achievements true fighter, savings, faster than evil - now works correctly
[*] new achievement added - endless mode - dark forest
[*] new achievement added - endless mode - swamp
[*] new achievement added - endless mode - hell
[/list]
[h3]Suond added:[/h3]
[list]
[*] skill holy wave sound added
[*] skill freezer sound added
[*] skill holy shield sound added
[/list]
[h3]Other assorted polish and tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] more credits added
[*] level 7 little wider - little harder
[*] blessing attack speed limited to 3 usages
[*] blessing golden gift added to the pool
[*] loader in-between levels - for the low end PC's
[*] level failed panel above tutorial canvas
[*] new preview for towers in the world map and bestiary - more info
[/list]

That's it for today. 
[h2]May your will be strong with the Light![/h2]
[h3]Kantal Collective & Hyperstrange[/h3]

[h1]Defenders of Eden![/h1]

We have some very important news for you regarding the release plans for [b]Otherwar[/b]. Our little indie game has been picked up by our friends at the indie development and publishing studio, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Hyperstrange][b]Hyperstrange[/b][/url], who believe we've got something special here, that deserves to be put in the spotlight. 

[previewyoutube=SpL80m7FR4Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Together with our new publisher we have made the call to give [b]Otherwar[/b] a little more time for fine polish, balancing, and working with community feedback. [b]Hyperstrange[/b] and [b]kantal collective[/b] are both firm believers in the indie development process without any other deadlines than those self-imposed. We want to make sure [b]Otherwar[/b] is as satisfying to play as it has been for us to develop.

Please make sure to wishlist the game...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1526870/Otherwar

... and stick around for more updates soon!

Shine your light, Defenders!

[b]kantal collective[/b]

notes.title: Update 13 - 66 days before the release, demo 2.0 and price of the game
notes.content:
[h1]Quick note[/h1]
We are 66 before the release day of Otherwar.  We have some more thing to do, but our excitement is huge, as we want to hit that release button and watch you playing the game.

The game is 10x bigger than the previous one, and the project was initially supposed to be completed in six months. Since the start in 2020, a lot of things have changed, from graphics to music and the main features of the game. Here are some screenshots to remind you of how it has changed:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463314/fc7d0fd92880bc12e628eb88ec355168c3455676.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463314/34dc2f8984c65d58544b3d9730d228fbb00be1b6.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463314/9e8e16df13245163ac184b1e702cb7ae5dc541ac.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463314/6c3c74ba19c9b1c89bfa64ddd95c46938e836c1c.png[/img]

[h1]Zawartość gry[/h1]
Otherwar is an action tower defense with an active hero, unlockable skills and a huge content (as project after hours).
- 9 levels
- 9 towers
- 19 enemies 
- 3 bosses
- 12 skills
- 24 achievements
- 4 languages

[h1]Price of the game and optional dlcs[/h1]
Price of the game at release will be 5$ (with -15% discount), and optional DLC:
- Buy me a coffee - 1.99$ -mini art book, unused art
- Buy me a pizza - 9.99$ - mini art book, unused art game, creation progress
- Buy me a dinner - 19.99$ - mini art book, unused art game creation progress, early demos
*DLC's doesn't affect the main game content

[h1]Demo 2.0[/h1]
On September 1, we plan to release demo 2.0, enhanced with the features you asked for, including crosshair and support for resolutions greater than Full HD.

[h1]Concept art[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463314/76a10b0f1821f4257927a0b9c234cd6ac58a0958.png[/img]
